title: AutoRubric: Rubric-Based Generative Rewards for Faithful Multimodal Reasoning

rs.key_step: 从自身成功轨迹聚合共同checkpoints，文本judge按rubric逐条判定，再混入终局reward。
rs.why_non_obvious: 不用完整人工过程标签，但共同出现仅是因果必要性的启发，不能证明faithfulness。
rs.trigger_condition: When outcome labels hide reasoning inconsistencies, aggregate recurring successful steps into instance-specific rubric rewards.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When outcome labels hide reasoning inconsistencies, aggregate recurring successful steps into instance-specific rubric rewards.

signatures.information: 已知GT筛选的成功轨迹、text-only judge与rubric
signatures.failure_boundary: judge不重看图，rubric可能继承共同视觉错误；strict仅reasoning与answer一致性不是因果faithfulness。

relevance.how: 把过程检查变为trajectory级辅助reward，仍非局部token credit。
caption/视觉reward可能被text-only judge共识误导。
